SELECT A.*, CASE WHEN A.CNT = 0 THEN '2' WHEN (A.ATTEND_CNT/A.CNT)*100 >= #{cert_percent} THEN '1' ELSE '2' END AS STUDENT_STATUS FROM ( SELECT a.STUDENT_IDX, a.STUDENT_NAME, a.STUDENT_ADDRESS, a.STUDENT_ADDRESS_DETAIL, a.STUDENT_BIRTH, a.STUDENT_OLD , (SELECT TEACH_COUNT FROM TEACH WHERE HOMEPAGE_ID = a.HOMEPAGE_ID AND GROUP_IDX = a.GROUP_IDX AND CATEGORY_IDX = a.CATEGORY_IDX AND TEACH_IDX = a.TEACH_IDX) AS CNT , (SELECT NVL(SUM(DECODE(status, '1', 1, '2', 1, 0)) - TRUNC(SUM(DECODE(status, '2', 1, 0))/3), 0) FROM TEACH_BOOK WHERE HOMEPAGE_ID = a.HOMEPAGE_ID AND GROUP_IDX = a.GROUP_IDX AND CATEGORY_IDX = a.CATEGORY_IDX AND TEACH_IDX = a.TEACH_IDX AND STUDENT_IDX = a.STUDENT_IDX) as ATTEND_CNT FROM STUDENT a WHERE a.DELETE_YN = 'N' AND a.HOMEPAGE_ID = #{homepage_id} AND a.GROUP_IDX = #{group_idx} AND a.CATEGORY_IDX = #{category_idx} AND a.TEACH_IDX = #{teach_idx} ) A
